title: A Student's Interview
text:
Tom is a student at a music school. Last week he gave an interview to a school magazine. The reporter asked him why he likes playing the piano. Tom said that music makes him feel calm and happy.

The reporter also asked about his plans. Tom wants to study music in another city next year. He hopes to play in a big concert one day.

questions.text: What does Tom want to do next year?
How does Tom probably feel about music?
options: He only plays it for money

questions.text: Why did the magazine most likely want to interview Tom?
options: He is a talented young musician

vocabulary.definition: a meeting where someone asks a person questions
a set of printed pages with articles, published regularly
an event where people play music for an audience
relaxed and not worried or nervous

paragraph_translations: Том є учнем музичної школи. Минулого тижня він дав інтерв'ю шкільному журналу. Репортер запитав його, чому він любить грати на фортепіано. Том сказав, що музика робить його спокійним і щасливим.
Репортер також запитав про його плани. Том хоче наступного року вчитися музики в іншому місті. Він сподівається колись виступити на великому концерті.
